newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's gross grain harvest at 63.5 mln T so far.
newsitem.headline: Russia's gross grain harvest at 63.5 mln T so far.

text.p: Russia had threshed a total 63.5 million tonnes bunker weight of grain as of Monday, with gross grain output on large farms at 58.9 million tonnes, State Statistics Committee figures showed on Thursday.
The committee released the following figures for output on formerly state-run collective farms, which account for 93 percent of Russia's total area sown to grain:
PACE OF RUSSIAN GRAIN HARVEST AS OF SEPT 23
The committee said that 8.0 million hectares of grain remained to be harvested, including 6.1 million in Siberia.

Winter crops had been sown to 9.7 million hectares so far, 13 percent below the same time last year. Nearly 18 million hectares had been prepared as of Monday for spring sowing, below the 23.6 million ready at this time last year.
